examPattern: Mid-Sem: 2 Hours (30 Marks) | End-Sem: 3 Hours (50 Marks) | Practical/Lab: 20 Marks

units.title: Core Python Syntax, Data Structures & NumPy
topics: Python Execution Model, Dynamic Typing, Control Flow, and Scoping Rules (LEGB)
Built-in Data Structures: Lists, Tuples, Dictionaries, Sets - Complexity and Operations
Functions: Positional/Keyword Arguments, *args, **kwargs, Lambda Functions, Closures, Decorators
Object-Oriented Programming: Classes, Instances, Inheritance, Magic Methods, Polymorphism
NumPy N-Dimensional Arrays (ndarray): Creation, Indexing, Slicing, Reshaping, Strides
NumPy Vectorization, Broadcasting Rules, Universal Functions (ufunc), Linear Algebra (np.linalg)

units.title: Pandas Data Analysis & Matplotlib Visualization
topics: Pandas Series and DataFrame Fundamentals: Creation, Reading CSV/JSON/SQL Datasets
Data Indexing and Selection: loc vs iloc, Boolean Masking, MultiIndex
Data Cleaning: Handling Missing Values (isna, fillna, dropna), Duplicate Removal, String Methods
Group Operations: Split-Apply-Combine Pattern, Aggregation, Transformation, Pivot Tables
Matplotlib Architecture: Figure, Axes, Line Plots, Scatter Plots, Histograms, Subplots
Seaborn Statistical Data Visualization: Heatmaps, Pairplots, Boxplots, Violin Plots

textbooks: Wes McKinney, 'Python for Data Analysis: Data Wrangling with pandas, NumPy, and Jupyter', 3rd Edition, O'Reilly
Mark Lutz, 'Learning Python', 5th Edition, O'Reilly Media
references: Jake VanderPlas, 'Python Data Science Handbook', O'Reilly Media
Luciano Ramalho, 'Fluent Python', 2nd Edition, O'Reilly Media
